features: Cinematic Surround Sound by Dolby Audio: Elevate your personal audio landscape with Dolby Audio engineering. By re-architecting how sound waves travel, it unrolls a wide, theater-grade soundstage right inside your ears, delivering breathtaking multi-directional depth that makes movies and live music feel incredibly spacious.

Marathon 45 Hours Total Playback: Enjoy uninterrupted entertainment that stretches across your entire week. This robust battery setup yields a massive 45 hours of total backup, combining the endurance of the earbuds and the charging case to completely remove the daily scramble of hunting for a Type-C cable.

Quad Mics with AI-ENx Technology: Step into busy city streets or windy office corridors with full vocal confidence. An advanced four-microphone array utilizes smart artificial intelligence algorithms to isolate your speech while suppressing background traffic noise and chatter, ensuring your calls stay crisp and boardroom-ready.

11mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Dive into a dense, beautifully textured audio landscape driven by high-performance 11mm dynamic drivers. Meticulously tuned to deliver our iconic boAt Signature Sound, they push out a deep, punchy low-end response perfectly balanced under clear vocals for a highly energetic listening experience.

Seamless Multipoint Connectivity: Redefine your multi-device workflow by linking your earbuds to two separate media sources simultaneously. This intelligent pairing engine lets you focus on an audio presentation on your office computer and fluidly routes audio over the moment an urgent phone call hits your mobile screen.
